'''Osadia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Its location was kept secret and removed off the [[Star map/Legends|star-charts]] so that the [[New Generation Academy|mysterious school]] that was located there could not be disturbed.

==History==
Osadia was a remote [[Tree/Legends|forested]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and was the home of the [[New Generation Academy]], which was directed by [[Demagol|Antos Wyrick]]. The mysterious school that hosted young [[Youngling/Legends|children]], such as [[Jarael]] and [[Chantique]] in their childhood, was in trade with the [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] organization [[the Crucible]]. At some point business between the Academy and the Crucible went bad. The Crucible reacted by having [[Fleet Captain/Legends|Fleet Captain]] [[Dace Golliard]] lead a massive attack on the school in an attempt to acquire students for their slaving ring.

As of [[3963 BBY]], the Crucible was still using the planet as a base of operations.

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Although ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''{{'s}} Appendix located the [[Osadia system/Legends|Osadia system]] in the Core Worlds, the planet was placed near the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories's]] world of [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]] on the map detailing the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="Atlas" />
